description: Cancel a previously posted task. Use when the task is no longer needed or was posted in error. If no worker has been assigned, the full budget is refunded. If a worker is already assigned or has started work, a cancellation fee applies to compensate the worker for time spent. The response includes the exact refund amount and any fees. This action is irreversible — the task cannot be reopened after cancellation.
name: cancel_task
title: Cancel Task
